nodes.description: Address authorized to set the migration contract (PreStaking.manager).
Immutable IERC20 interface of the token approved for deposits.
IAcceptsDeposit address used as migration target, set once by manager.
Immutable timestamp after which deposits are rejected.
Immutable timestamp before which withdrawals are locked.
Immutable minimum deposit amount required to qualify.
Mapping of depositor address to deposited token amount.
Mapping of depositor address to claimed virtual balance.
Public merkle root used to verify virtual balance claims (MerkleClaim.merkleRoot).
BitMaps.BitMap tracking claimed merkle leaf indices (MerkleClaim.claimed).
Initializes manager, deposit token, deposit end time, withdraw unlock time and minimum deposit.
ERC777 recipient hook that records deposited tokens for a depositor.
Manager-only one-time setter of the migration contract, approving it as spender.
Manager-only setter that delegates to _setMerkleRoot.
Verifies a merkle proof and credits virtual balance to msg.sender.
Moves a depositor's deposited balance to the migration contract.
Moves a depositor's virtual balance to the migration contract.
Withdraws staked tokens after the unlock time has passed.
Modifier restricting execution to the configured manager address.
Internal one-time merkle root setter with zero-address checks.
Internal claim routine: checks bitmap, verifies proof, marks index claimed.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization and balance indexing.
Miner-influenceable timestamp used for deposit and withdraw time gates.
Original transaction sender; declared untrusted input (not referenced in code).
External call depositToken.approve(migrationContract, type(uint256).max) granting unlimited allowance.
External call migrationContract.migrateDeposit(msg.sender, amount) executed after balance decrement.
External call migrationContract.migrateVirtualBalance(msg.sender, amount) executed after balance decrement.
External call depositToken.transfer(msg.sender, amount) sending staked tokens out.
Arithmetic update depositorBalance[from] += amount inside tokensReceived.
Arithmetic update depositorBalance[msg.sender] -= amount inside migrateDeposit.
Arithmetic update depositorBalance[msg.sender] -= amount inside withdraw.
Arithmetic update virtualBalance[msg.sender] += amount inside claimVirtualBalance.
Arithmetic update virtualBalance[msg.sender] -= amount inside migrateVirtualBalance.
Address parameter of setMigrationContract naming the migration target.
Amount parameter of claimVirtualBalance credited to virtualBalance.
Merkle leaf index parameter of claimVirtualBalance.
Merkle proof array parameter of claimVirtualBalance.
ERC777 sender address parameter of tokensReceived used as balance key.
Root hash parameter of setMerkleRoot.
Amount parameter of tokensReceived added to the depositor balance.
Amount parameter of migrateDeposit deducted from depositor balance.
Amount parameter of migrateVirtualBalance deducted from virtual balance.
Amount parameter of withdraw transferred to msg.sender.
Local hash leaf of _claim computed from index, account and amount.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns the manager authorization address.
Constructor stores the deposit token interface.
Constructor stores the minimum deposit requirement.
depositEndTime is derived from block.timestamp plus an offset.
withdrawUnlockTime is derived from block.timestamp plus an offset.
tokensReceived executes depositorBalance[from] += amount.
Existing depositorBalance value is read and incremented.
The received amount parameter feeds the balance increment.
The 'from' parameter indexes the depositorBalance mapping.
tokensReceived requires msg.sender to equal the deposit token.
msg.sender is the untrusted caller validated in tokensReceived.
tokensReceived compares block.timestamp against depositEndTime.
depositEndTime gates whether the deposit is accepted.
minimumDeposit is required to be met by the depositor balance.
The ERC777 'from' value originates from the caller-initiated token transfer.
setMigrationContract writes the migrationContract state variable.
The _migrationContract parameter is stored into migrationContract.
setMigrationContract approves the migration contract to spend deposit tokens.
depositToken is the token whose allowance is being granted.
The _migrationContract parameter is used as the approved spender.
onlyManager guards setMigrationContract from unauthorized callers.
onlyManager guards setMerkleRoot from unauthorized callers.
setMerkleRoot delegates the state write to _setMerkleRoot.
The _virtualBalanceMerkleRoot parameter flows into _setMerkleRoot.
msg.sender is compared against the manager address in the modifier.
The manager state variable is the authorization reference.
_setMerkleRoot writes the merkleRoot state variable.
merkleRoot is read to enforce the one-time set requirement.
The claimed bitmap is read to prevent double claiming.
merkleRoot is used as the root for proof verification.
The merkleProof parameter is consumed by the verification routine.
The index parameter is used for the bitmap check and leaf encoding.
_claim computes the local leaf hash.
The computed leaf is passed to MerkleProof.verify.
_claim sets the claimed bit for the processed index.
claimVirtualBalance invokes the internal _claim routine.
msg.sender is the account credited by claimVirtualBalance.
The amount parameter drives the credited virtual balance.
claimVirtualBalance performs virtualBalance[msg.sender] += amount.
Existing virtualBalance value is read and incremented.
The claimed amount parameter feeds the virtual balance increment.
msg.sender indexes the virtualBalance mapping.
migrateDeposit performs depositorBalance[msg.sender] -= amount.
Existing depositorBalance value is read and decremented.
The migration amount parameter feeds the balance decrement.
msg.sender indexes the depositorBalance mapping.
migrateDeposit reads migrationContract to ensure it is set before the external call.
migrateDeposit invokes an external call on the migration contract after the balance decrement.
migrationContract is the target of the external migrateDeposit call.
msg.sender is forwarded as the depositor argument to the migration contract.
The amount parameter is forwarded to the migration contract.
The external migration contract call can re-enter migrateDeposit before state finalization.
migrateVirtualBalance performs virtualBalance[msg.sender] -= amount.
Existing virtualBalance value is read and decremented.
The migration amount parameter feeds the virtual balance decrement.
msg.sender indexes the virtualBalance mapping.
migrateVirtualBalance reads migrationContract before the external call.
migrateVirtualBalance invokes an external call on the migration contract after the balance decrement.
migrationContract is the target of the external migrateVirtualBalance call.
msg.sender is forwarded as the depositor argument to the migration contract.
The amount parameter is forwarded to the migration contract.
The external migration contract call can re-enter migrateVirtualBalance before state finalization.
withdraw requires block.timestamp to be at or past withdrawUnlockTime.
withdrawUnlockTime gates whether withdrawal is allowed.
msg.sender is the untrusted account withdrawing its own balance.
withdraw performs depositorBalance[msg.sender] -= amount.
Existing depositorBalance value is read and decremented.
The withdraw amount parameter feeds the balance decrement.
msg.sender indexes the depositorBalance mapping.
withdraw performs an external token transfer after the balance decrement.
depositToken is the token contract being called for the transfer.
msg.sender is the recipient of the transferred tokens.
The amount parameter is the value transferred to the caller.
The token transfer external call can re-enter withdraw before state finalization.

normalization_plan.reason: The address parameter only supplies the migrationContract state write in this function.
The amount parameter is only used to increment the caller's virtual balance.
The index parameter is only consumed by the bitmap check and leaf encoding in _claim.
The proof array parameter is only consumed by the merkle verification in _claim.
The ERC777 sender parameter only indexes depositorBalance within tokensReceived.
The root parameter is only written into merkleRoot by the internal setter.
The received amount only feeds the depositorBalance increment operation.
The amount parameter is forwarded to the external migration call and its balance decrement.
The amount parameter is forwarded to the external migration call and its balance decrement.
The amount parameter determines the size of the outbound token transfer.
The leaf local variable is only used inside _claim for proof verification.
